verdicts.reason: A keeps the can inside its circle backdrop, so the product imagery survives. But the GLACIER wordmark sits below the headline, the body copy is shrunk to illegible micro-text and jammed beside the badges, the CTA row is pressed against the bottom edge, and a large dead area is left on the left. B pulls the circle away from the can, leaving a meaningless empty disc on the left and a can floating with no backdrop. It also has GLACIER below the headline and a small CTA that gets no more weight than the badges, though its body copy is readable and its text block is tidier.
